questions.stem: activeStudent 1: Hi, I feel really upset these days. I always forget English words quickly.Student 2: Oh, that’s not a good thing, but forgetting is totally normal! 1. __________.Student 1: Really? Then what methods can I use? Could you tell me?Student 2: __________. For example, you can take notes often, and do some brain training.Student 1: Taking notes? 3. __________?Student 2: When you take notes, you write down what you’ve learned. Then you can review it regularly.Repeat this again and again, and you’ll remember the words well. As the saying goes, "A good memory isnot as good as a bad pen. "Student 1: That makes sense! 4. __________?Student 2: Of course. Brain training can help improve your memory ability.
opts: Sure! There are a few good ways.
Can you introduce other memory methods too
I’ll try my best to do these things and improve my memory
What are the benefits of that?
You can practice more to improve your memory.
questions.expl: ：现在，他已经找到了自己的学习方法。
本文介绍提高记忆的方法。
本文是一篇说明文。主要通过记忆的工作原理告诉我们如何提高记忆力，如何高效记单词。
：安迪感觉自己的脸变热了，他焦急地放下铅笔。 dirty 脏的；bright 明亮的；hot 热的；fat 胖的。根据“he set his pencil down anxiously”可知，安迪因 为焦虑脸变热了。故选C。
：这不是他第一次交白卷了。 book 书；paper 试卷；diary 日记；menu 菜单。根据上文“Mr. Crane started collecting (收) the test paper” 可知，此处指交白卷。故选B。

理解题。根据“Memories of experiences (e. g., our first day at school) and of factual knowledge (e. g., the capital of France) are declarative memories. ”以及“However, he could never remember having been trained to learn a new skill. In other words, Molaison could develop new procedural, but not declarative, memories. ” 以及陈述性记忆包括factual knowledge 可知术后他无法形成新的陈述性 记忆，即记不住事实知识。故选C。
判断题。根据“You can do this by writing new sentences that include it. ”可知，你可以通过写 包含它的新句子来记忆。故选C。
大意题。根据全文内容可知，主要讲述了如何提高记忆力。故选A。

questions.stem: In the first paragraph, the writer leads into the topic by __________.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“Many of us learn how to ride a bicycle at a young age. As we grow older, we may stop riding—most of us go to school by bus or by subway. But whenever we get on a bicycle, it’s like we’ve never stopped biking…”可知第一段以“骑自行车”为例，引出本文主题，故选B。

questions.stem: Which of the following is about a procedural memory?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Skills such as playing an instrument or riding a bike are procedural memories” 可 知程序性记忆与技能相关，游泳是一种技能，属于程序性记忆。故选D。

questions.stem: What might be Henry Gustav Molaison’s new problem after the operation in the 1950s?
opts: He couldn’t learn a new skill.

questions.stem: The idiom “It is just like riding a bicycle” probably means “__________. ”
opts: Once learned, it is never forgotten
It’s never too late to learn
You should learn with all your heart
People can learn from their mistakes
